proposals.name: loss_streak_cooloff_3
proposals.rationale: Pause new entries after 3 closed consecutive losses (causal: only trades with exit before decision). Cuts churn during loss runs that hurt eth_multitrade_v1_1.
proposals.economic: Avoid stacking books while the model is in a temporary failure mode.

proposals.name: strength_quantile_p75
proposals.rationale: Raise mean_strength threshold to 75th percentile of lookback |mean|; prior p75 transfer on ETH K5 increased expectancy_return_units.
proposals.economic: Trade only higher-conviction signals to raise edge per unit.
forbidden: combine with cooloff in same generation

proposals.name: skip_high_vol_low_strength
proposals.rationale: Shared elevated buckets often pair high vol with weak signal; shared_examples=['str=mid|vol=low|side=-1|book=1|ex=max_hold|ww1=True', 'str=low|vol=low|side=-1|book=1|ex=max_hold|ww1=True'].
proposals.economic: Avoid noisy high-vol entries with low absolute model score.
forbidden: fit vol cutoffs on outer OOS

proposals.name: book1_extra_strength
proposals.rationale: Historically book1 is noisier; require stronger |mean| only on primary.
proposals.economic: Improve first-entry quality without starving add-ons.

proposals.name: causal_recent_hit_rate_feature
proposals.rationale: Only if gate arms fail: add causal rolling hit-rate of prior closed trades as a LightGBM feature (train-fold fit only).
proposals.economic: Let the model learn temporary cold spells without OOS labels.
